entities.definition: A callable operation of an API contract
entities.reasoning: SDEM extension: ArchiMate has no element for a single API operation (it stops at the interface). SDEM adds it because BIAN's Semantic API maps each service operation to one REST operation (Practitioner Guide §3.5), and its attributes follow the public OpenAPI standard (method, path, payload).
entities.confidence_basis: built on a standard concept as SDEM chose to model it
